subject: Re: Eval materials exchange — MAP, acceptance criteria, and takedown cadence
messages:
From: Priya Malhotra <priya@brightretail.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Thompson <sam@lumencart.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Eval materials exchange & timeline

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to move forward with a short evaluation: a small corpus of BrightRetail customer support transcripts + two prompt packs (search & summarization) to run locally in your sandbox. We want a mutual action plan that covers: what we can run against the materials, retention and deletion timeline, and acceptance criteria for the trial.

High level asks from our side:
- 2 week sandbox period with ephemeral keys
- Token limits per day and a rolling kv-cache (details below)
- Clear acceptance test: macro-agreement on precision/recall thresholds for the summary prompts and PII redaction checks

Attached is a sample manifest (bright-retail-eval-sample-list.csv) with redacted rows for PII. Can you propose a MAP and a proposed close timeline? Also include any standard usage covenants — BrightRetail is strict about data handling and audit trails.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Malhotra
Head of Data & ML Partnerships | BrightRetail
ph: +1 415 555 0134
[attachment: bright-retail-eval-sample-list.csv (csv)]
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Priya Malhotra <priya@brightretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval materials exchange & timeline

Priya —

Appreciate the clarity. Attaching a draft MAP and a short promptpack README for review (redwood-mpa-draft-v1.pdf, promptpack-preview-readme.md). High-level proposal below; I'll follow up with Marissa on operational steps.

Proposed MAP (summary):
- Kickoff: we accept sample manifest and confirm PII redaction (today + 24h)
- Provisioning: 48h staging window; ephemeral sandbox credentials (2-week lease)
- Limits: 250k tokens/day during pilot; KV-cache snapshot retained for 7 days unless otherwise agreed
- Acceptance: BrightRetail to run the 20 canonical acceptance prompts; success = >= 85% F1 on entity extraction checks and >= 0.75 ROUGE-L for summarization (both measured on the seeded acceptance set)
- Takedown: At pilot end day +2 we will permanently delete uploaded materials and snapshot artifacts; audit log (S3-styled) available for 90 days per your policy

Open items for us to confirm:
1) BrightRetail wants automatic KV-cache disabled after the acceptance run? (We can disable or provide a rolling window.)
2) Any regulatory paperwork (NDA + Data Processing Addendum) you need executed before we accept the sample?

Attachments: redwood-mpa-draft-v1.pdf (MPA draft - operational clauses + deletion cadence)
promptpack-preview-readme.md (what we run inside sandbox; includes a sample evaluation harness)

If this looks OK I’ll route the MPA to DocuSign and loop Marissa to coordinate the staging window and manifest ingest.

—
Jonas Weber
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
From: Priya Malhotra <priya@brightretail.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Thompson <sam@lumencart.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 08:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval materials exchange & timeline

Jonas —

Thanks, that structure is helpful. Quick responses inline:

- KV-cache: we prefer automatic KV-cache disabled for the pilot. We'll run the acceptance set under deterministic conditions.
- Paperwork: we have an amended DPA and a short SOW for the pilot; I’ve attached the SOW draft in this reply (see inline). We can sign the DPA in parallel but want the SOW to reference the token limits and deletion cadence you proposed.

Couple of clarifications on acceptance tests:
- For entity extraction (F1): can you provide the scoring harness you’ll use so we can reproduce locally?
- For summarization (ROUGE-L): we accept 0.75 as baseline, but want a per-document quality check for top-10 regressions before we close — if regressions exist we iterate up to 2 additional prompt refinements.

If we can get the MPA on DocuSign by EOD Friday we’ll sign and schedule the sample upload for Monday morning.

PRIYA
—
Priya Malhotra
Head of Data & ML Partnerships | BrightRetail
[attachment: brightretail-pilot-sow-draft.docx (docx)]

Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2027 09:26:00 -0800

Hi all —

Quick ops notes from infra/serving:
- Sandbox config: we’ll provision a dedicated ephemeral cluster (g4dn-like) with isolated KV-store. Rolling window option = keep last 7 days of KV; we’ll disable auto-cache for the pilot as requested.
- Token throttles: enforced at the routing layer; 250k tokens/day default is fine. If BrightRetail needs burst capacity during acceptance runs we can pre-authorize a single-day bump to 400k (must be requested 24h in advance).
- Audit: We’ll provide an S3-style audit export and a signed checksum of deleted artifacts after takedown.

Deliverables I’ll need from BrightRetail before we ingest: sanitized manifest (CSV), acceptance prompt set (20 items), and the SOW signature. Please keep the manifest rows redacted for PII as you have.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
